annotations.text:
OceanSentinel command center in the Mapbox system, with three borrowings from Checkly (mono data, hairline rows, status pills) and one documented deviation: a risk color scale used only on risk.

All four screens show the real composite scenario: FV Night Hauler, risk 100, four evidence lines, the dark segment, the closure.

Command Center: map is the light source; watchlist and events left, vessel panel right, replay bar bottom.
Case: three columns, evidence snapshot frozen at creation, audit log, dismiss reasons as chips.
Analyst: grounded answers with mono data and a provider badge.
Replay: scenario picker, the agents' story as a timeline, uncertainty ring while dark.
Source of truth for implementation is design/DESIGN.md in the repo. This sheet is the visual companion: surfaces, text, the one blue, the risk scale, type, controls, rows, map legend.
Earlier direction sketches kept for the record. The chosen direction became the Mapbox-based system on the Screens page.
